Name: K10_FTW's Woods Wainscotting Walls and Floors for Alternative Textures
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: K10_FTW's Walls and floors featuring wood wainscoting in a variety of stains and designs, with matching assorted wood floor textures. Converted for use with Alternative Textures.
Description:
This is an [Alternative Textures](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246?tab=description) content pack. This content packs will add texture variation to wallpaper and floor objects in Stardew Valley. When placing supported objects, it has a chance to use the default game texture or one of the texture variations supplied by any AT content pack. If you'd like to change the texture of the placed item, you can use the Paint Bucket tool on it. This tool is purchasable from Robin.

All items in this pack are tagged to make them easier to find with the in-built search function. By default all AT content packs are tagged with the UniqueId in the manifest.json. Additional tags include:

For Floors: [ "K10_FTW", "krissymarie", "Wood", "Wainscoting" ],

For Walls:  [ "K10_FTW", "krissymarie", "Wood", "Wainscoting", "Bars", "Bookshelf", "Brick", "Half", "Panelled", "Patterned", "Plain" ],

This mod is compatible with most mods and is easy to install and uninstall. To install just drop it in your mods folder. To remove, just delete the folder. As a result it is possible to just use the furniture pack and not the wallpapers and flooring and vice versa, just delete the folders containing the assets you don't want.
